title: Munnar Tea Gardens Retreat
description: Escape to the lush green hills of Munnar. Surrounded by endless tea plantations and misty mountains, experience nature like never before.

title: Wayanad Wildlife & Nature
description: Discover the pristine beauty of Wayanad. From ancient caves to magnificent waterfalls, this is a perfect getaway for families and nature lovers.

title: Ooty Queen of Hill Stations
description: Step into the charm of Ooty. Enjoy peaceful boat rides, expansive botanical gardens, and the breathtaking views from Doddabetta peak.

title: Kodaikanal Serene Escapade
description: Experience the tranquility of Kodaikanal. Walk among pine forests, gaze at the pillar rocks, and enjoy a romantic getaway by the lake.

title: Chikkamagaluru Coffee Trails
description: Dive into the coffee capital of Karnataka. Trek up Mullayanagiri, wander through vast estates, and witness the majestic Hebbe Falls.

title: Goa Beaches & Heritage
description: Sun, sand, and historic churches. Explore the vibrant beaches of North Goa, taste incredible seafood, and visit ancient basilicas.

title: Varanasi Spiritual Journey
description: Embark on a soulful pilgrimage to one of the oldest living cities. Witness the mesmerizing Ganga Aarti and seek blessings at Kashi Vishwanath.
